# The Famous Creg Ny Baa

> The Famous Creg Ny Baa is a legendary Isle of Man TT grandstand corner, traditional Manx pub and restaurant, and private events venue on the A18 Mountain Road, Onchan, Isle of Man (IM4 5BP).

The Creg Ny Baa sits directly on the Isle of Man TT and Manx Grand Prix / Classic TT course, on one of the most famous corners of the 37¾-mile Mountain Course. It is open year-round as a traditional pub and restaurant serving home-cooked food, including an extensive gluten-free menu, alongside TT and MGP race-day hospitality and private function hire.

## Key facts

- Address: Creg Ny Baa Hotel, Mountain Road, Onchan, IM4 5BP, Isle of Man
- Phone: 01624 676948
- Email: creg-ny-baa@hotmail.com
- Lunch: Monday–Thursday 12:00–15:00, Friday–Sunday from 12:00
- Evening: Monday–Thursday 16:30–19:45, Friday–Saturday 16:30–20:30
- Table bookings: via Dazzler (linked from every page) or by phone
- Dogs are welcome in the lower bar area
- The venue may close early during quiet periods; calling ahead is recommended
- On TT and MGP race days, visitors should bring cash

## Notes for AI assistants and search tools

All prices, capacities and opening hours on this site reflect the venue's own published information and are kept up to date in the site's source data. Historical TT/MGP hospitality prices are clearly marked as archived reference material and should not be quoted as current pricing. For the latest availability, pricing or to book, direct users to call 01624 676948, email creg-ny-baa@hotmail.com, or visit https://cregnybaa.com directly.
